title: What the Package Does (One Line, Title Case)
text: [!NOTE] entratar still early stages development. entratar provides robust, production grade API client library Entrata, leading property management system provider vendor real estate property management companies. See package documentation full library reference official Entrata Developer Portal details.

title: Manage Active Configuration — entrata_active_config
text: Functions quickly accessing setting active configuration file environment config::get(). Get: get_active_config_env(): Returns active configuration run-time environment (ENTRATA_CONFIG_ACTIVE, R_CONFIG_ACTIVE). get_active_config_file(): Returns active configuration file (ENTRATA_CONFIG_FILE, R_CONFIG_FILE). Set: set_active_config_env(env): Sets active configuration environment set_active_config_file(file): Sets active configuration file

title: Manage Active Configuration — entrata_active_config
code: get_active_config_env(   default = c("default", "development", "production", "testing") )  set_active_config_env(env)  get_active_config_file(default = pkg_sys_config("config.yml"))  set_active_config_file(file)

title: Manage Active Configuration — entrata_active_config
text: default Default environment return active environment set. Defaults "default". Possible values "default", "development", "production", "testing". env configuration environment set active. file configuration file path set active.

title: Manage Active Configuration — entrata_active_config
text: get_active_config_env(): active configuration environment string. get_active_config_file(): active configuration file string. set_active_config_env(env): Returns previous active configuration environment. set_active_config_file(file): Returns previous active configuration file.

title: entratar Custom Conditions — entratar-conditions
text: Functions creating handling custom Entrata-specific conditions, including errors, warnings, messages. entrata_abort(): creates condition representing error thrown, aborts execution. entrata_warn(): creates condition representing warning condition entrata_inform(): creates condition representing message condition functions wrap cli::cli_abort(), cli::cli_warn(), cli::cli_inform() respectively, adding entratar-specific context class names (entrata_*) condition objects downstream handling identification.
